name: Requests a router would actually see
description: The corpus F1 said was missing. The 134 borrowed cases are a PII detector's samples with a median length of 34 characters, and the complexity axis has nothing to read in them -- it changed 0 of those 134 outcomes. These are requests for work, which is what a router is pointed at. Bands are labelled against the definition `tools/measure_router.py` puts to a model, verbatim: low means a small local model will answer adequately, moderate means it will probably manage but a larger one would answer better, high means it needs the larger model. Labelled that way on purpose and NOT by what iriguchi's rules would say -- grading an estimator against its own output measures nothing. Every prompt is invented; every address, key and name in one is a placeholder.

samples.prompt: 次の文章の誤字脱字を直してください。「本日はお忙しい中お集まり頂き有り難うございます。」
samples.note: Proofreading is the canonical small-model task. Invented.

samples.prompt: Fix the spelling and grammar in this sentence: 'Their going to send there report by friday.'
samples.note: The English half of the same task, so the script asymmetry is measurable. Invented.

samples.prompt: この記事を三行で要約してください。
samples.note: Summarising to a fixed length. Invented.

samples.prompt: Summarise the paragraph above in two sentences, plain language.
Turn these bullet points into a short paragraph without adding anything.
以下の説明を箇条書きに直してください。順番は変えないでください。
この一文をもう少し丁寧な言い方に書き換えてください。「明日までに出してください。」
samples.note: Register change, a small model handles it. Invented.

samples.prompt: Translate this sentence into Japanese: 'The meeting has been moved to Thursday.'
List every date mentioned in the text above, one per line, in ISO format.
samples.note: Extraction with a fixed output shape. Invented.

samples.prompt: Convert this two-column CSV into a JSON array of objects. Keys: name, quantity.
この記事のタイトル案を五つ出してください。
Shorten this announcement to under 140 characters, keep the date.
Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists into one sorted list, and write unit tests covering the empty and single-element cases.
samples.note: Two parts, both routine. A small model usually manages. Invented.

samples.prompt: この関数に docstring を付けて、境界値のテストも書いてください。
Explain the difference between a process and a thread, with one example of when you would choose each.
samples.note: Common knowledge, but the example has to be apt. Invented.

samples.prompt: Draft a short email declining a vendor's proposal, giving two reasons, without closing the door on future work.
samples.note: Constrained writing with a tone requirement. Invented.

samples.prompt: Look at this SELECT and tell me whether the join will duplicate rows, and which column would be worth an index.
この設計案について、懸念点を三つ挙げてください。
Rewrite this recursive function as an iterative one and say what the stack depth was before.
Summarise the plan above and list the operational risks it implies but does not mention.
この正規表現が何にマッチするか説明して、マッチしない例を二つ挙げてください。
Rewrite this error message so a non-engineer can act on it, and keep the error code.
この整列アルゴリズムの計算量が O(n log n) であることを証明してください。
samples.note: Thirty-odd characters and it needs a proof. The short-and-hard trap in Japanese. Invented.

samples.prompt: Prove that this loop invariant holds on entry, on each iteration, and at exit.
Compare an event-sourced design against a CRUD one for this service, weigh the operational cost of each, and recommend one with your reasoning.
samples.note: Trade-off reasoning with a recommendation to justify. Invented.

samples.prompt: この分散システムで結果整合性と強整合性のどちらを採るべきか、失敗モードを踏まえて論証してください。
Latency rose in the API, the queue depth stayed flat, and the database CPU fell. Give the three most likely root causes, ranked, and say what evidence would separate them.
Plan the migration of this table to a new schema with zero downtime, including the rollback path and what makes it irreversible.
Refactor this module and explain why, step by step, with the alternatives you considered and rejected.
These two specifications contradict each other on retry behaviour. Work out which one the implementation follows, and propose a resolution that breaks neither caller.
Show that this lock-free queue is linearisable, or find the interleaving that breaks it.
なぜこの実装ではデッドロックが起きないのか、順序づけを踏まえて説明してください。
Derive the cost of running this pipeline at ten times the current volume, state every assumption, and say which one dominates.
